# Change Description

Please provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does and why it is needed.  
If this PR addresses any related issues, please mention them like `Closes #123`, `Fixes #456`.

---

## Type of Changes

Check the boxes that apply:

- [ ] 🐛 `fix`: This change fixes a bug.
- [ ] ✨ `feat`: This change adds a new feature.
- [ ] 📝 `docs`: Documentation-only changes.
- [ ] ♻️ `refactor`: Code refactoring or restructuring (no change in functionality).
- [ ] 🧪 `test`: Adding or updating tests.
- [ ] 🔧 `chore`: Maintenance tasks, dependency updates, etc.

---

## How Has This Been Tested?

Describe briefly how you tested your changes:  
For example:
1. Clone the branch.
2. Run `go test ./...` or `make test`.
3. Verify that no existing tests fail.
4. Manually test commands: `./build.sh && ./deploy.sh --dry-run`.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I have followed the **coding style guidelines** (see CONTRIBUTING.md#4-coding-style-guidelines).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where applicable.
- [ ] My changes work on the supported environments (list versions).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation if my changes require it (README, examples, etc.).
- [ ] All CI checks have passed.

---

## Additional Comments

Include any additional information for the reviewers here.
